verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm, and immigration service providers could plausibly offer client-facing AI assistants, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only lawyer-led services: consultations, visa processing and compliance work. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant that can take delegated tasks, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
